title: Digital Root
description: Find the digital root of a number (repeated sum of digits until single digit).

data.text: Given a number `n`, repeatedly sum its digits until the result is a single digit. Return that digit.
Sum the digits, then recurse if the sum is still >= 10. O(log n) time.

data.title: Recursive O(log n)
data.content: Sum the digits, then recurse if the sum is still >= 10.

data.text: Loop summing digits until the result is a single digit. O(log n) time.

data.title: Iterative O(log n)
data.content: Loop summing digits until the result is a single digit.

data.text: Use the formula: digital root = 1 + (n - 1) % 9 for n > 0. O(1) time.

data.title: Mathematical O(1)
data.content: Use the formula: digital root = 1 + (n - 1) % 9 for n > 0.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: The mathematical formula is O(1) and avoids any looping or recursion. It exploits the congruence property of digital roots modulo 9.
